team-tdd.name: TDD Team
team-tdd.purpose: Deliver a feature using full-stack Test-Driven Development.
guardrails: Tests are written before production code.
Backend, then frontend, then E2E validation.
handoffs: integration -> run_fix: E2E tests → Run / fix

team-classic.name: Plan-Code-Test Team
team-classic.purpose: Deliver using plan, API contract, code, tests, E2E, security review, and documentation.
guardrails: Schema and API contract guide implementation.
handoffs: schematic -> api_contract: Schematic / plan → API contract
api_contract -> database: API contract → Database schema
test_and_verify -> integration: Layer tests → End-to-end tests
integration -> run_fix: E2E tests → Run / fix
run_fix -> review: Run / fix → Code review
review -> security: Code review → Security review

write_tests.mission: Write tests and acceptance criteria before any implementation (TDD).

code_backend.mission: Implement the API and server logic.

code_frontend.mission: Implement the UI and API client calls.

integration.mission: Validate the full UI + API journey.

run_fix.mission: Run all suites and apply targeted fixes.

document.mission: Document the deliverable and execution evidence.

schematic.mission: Plan and schematic the solution (modules, flows, interfaces) before coding.

api_contract.mission: Define shared routes and schemas before implementation.

test_and_verify.mission: Automated tests on backend and frontend.

course.title: Course module — theory and knobs
course.eyebrow: Decoder — one token at a time
course.intro: Maps decoding equations (one token at a time) to Live sampling labels. Click a knob to see symbols, formula, and references.
course.pickKnobHint: Select a knob in the chain or list to show details.

equations.logits_raw:
z_i = logit(token_i | context)
P_raw(i) propto exp(z_i)
equations.sample: token ~ Categorical(P')  after normalization on filtered pool
equations.logit_bias:
z'_i = z_i + bias_i
(bias_i set via logit_bias, token:id)
equations.repeat_penalty:
z'_i <- f(z_i, tokens_{t-N..t-1})
(f = repeat_penalty over window repeat_last_n)
equations.presence_penalty:
penalty if token/topic already present
(alpha_pres = presence_penalty)
equations.frequency_penalty:
penalty grows with token count
(alpha_freq = frequency_penalty)
equations.temperature:
P(i) propto exp(z'_i / T)
T = temperature  (low T -> deterministic)
equations.mirostat:
Mirostat loop (if mirostat in {1,2}):
  adaptive k, e = S(X) - tau,  mu <- mu - eta*e
  (eta = mirostat_eta, tau = mirostat_tau)
equations.mirostat_tau:
tau = mirostat_tau  (target surprise / perplexity)
S(X) = -log P_M(X)
equations.top_k:
V^(k) = {k highest-P tokens}
keep only i in V^(k)
equations.top_p:
V^(p) = smallest set with
  sum_{i in V^(p)} P(i) >= p
(p = top_p, nucleus sampling)
equations.min_p:
eligible(i) iff P(i) >= p_min
p_min = min_p
equations.num_predict:
stop if t >= T_max
T_max = num_predict
equations.stop:
stop if suffix(context+gen) contains s
s in stop list

workedExample.title: Worked example — toy vocabulary
workedExample.disclaimer: Illustration with made-up numbers so you can relate logits, softmax, sampling, then filters.

steps.title: Toy logits after the LM
steps.body:
Vocabulary {A,B,C}; raw logits before temperature:

z_A = 1.5   z_B = 1.2   z_C = -0.3

steps.title: Temperature T = 2
steps.body:
P(i) ∝ exp(z_i / T). Here exp(z/T) :

A → exp(0.75) ≈ 2.12
B → exp(0.60) ≈ 1.82
C → exp(-0.15) ≈ 0.86

Normalize so they sum to 1 (softmax).

steps.title: Drawing the next token
steps.body: Draw once from this categorical distribution; low T ⇒ peaked distribution (more deterministic), high T ⇒ flatter distribution.

steps.title: Top-k / Top-p applied before normalization
steps.body: UI filters trim the eligible set (see pipeline); after trimming, probs are renormalized on the remaining tokens, then sampled.

workedExample.closingNote: Real models use tens of thousands of tokens; UI knobs only change these same steps numerically.
